propositions: Focused prerequisite finder and verifier must run only for readable pinned direct dependencies, isolated from general review prompts, with stable lexicographic prerequisite ordering and no subject/prerequisite text splitting during context-limit recovery.

Every readable pinned prerequisite receives exactly one closed-schema disposition (consistent|finding|indeterminate) with deterministic reason codes; missing, duplicate, parse-invalid, or schema-invalid output maps to indeterminate/output-invalid; provider failure maps to indeterminate/evaluation-error.

Prerequisite-scoped findings use canonical four-field structured identity (version, finding text, criteria, prerequisite ID) with SHA-256 hash; non-prerequisite findings retain legacy pipe-delimited encoding unchanged.

Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record forces unsigned top-level INDETERMINATE verdict regardless of general findings; concurrent deterministic blockers remain visible in blocking array with coverage_indeterminate=true.

Singleton focused finder baseline must achieve recall≥0.90, false-acceptance≤0.10, coverage=1.00, attribution-error=0.00; packed calls must maintain baseline non-regression while retaining absolute floors.

Prerequisite-only Pass-2 verifier attribution field (yes|no|na) vetos incompatible findings via independent index domain; general and focused domains reshape separately then concatenate before single shared Pass-3 execution-review pipeline.
